results.title: Our Story - How Supersparks Was Built | Supersparks
results.content:
July 2022

The Spark

It all started 3 years ago, when I built breweriesnearby.com using Webflow and programmatic SEO - the inspiration came from a fellow indiehacker getting insane traffic on a directory site. The vision for this project was beyond just a Yellow Pages style directory - I wanted to create a reviews-based community where beer lovers could connect and bond over their brewery experiences, like Goodreads but for breweries.  
  
But no tool existed that could customize every element in Webflow to match my site design and integrate with membership platforms like Memberstack. After a frustrating weekend piecing together a half-baked solution using Airtable and Make, I thought: "There has to be a better way."  
That's how Supersparks was born.

.png)

Early 2023

Building Begins [...] 1. Allowed me to customize every element of my community / reviews experience in Webflow to match the design of the rest of my site
2. Could integrate with membership tools like Memberstack or Outseta, to display logged in members' profile details with their content
3. Wouldn't require to spend days coding or piecing together nocode tools with Zapier or Make

I ended up spending an entire weekend building a half-baked and guest only reviews system using Airtable and Make, which required me to embed slow and ugly Airtable forms, ate up CMS items (super precious on directories), and couldn't integrate with Memberstack or Outseta.

I thought to myself: "There has to be a better way" 🤔. And that's how Supersparks was born.

results.title: What is Supersparks?
results.content:
Getting Started

# What is Supersparks?

Supersparks is a nocode tool and library of power-ups for Webflow that enables user-generated content (UGC) and community in minutes. The three main features in our library include: commenting, reviews & ratings, community posting, and upvoting. We also offer a CMS audio player. These features unlock a wide-range of use cases that were previously not available for Webflow, including: forums, blog commenting, directory item reviews, recipe reviews, and much more.

## Full Design Control In Webflow
